review_description: Sales/Quoting process was quick.Installed by RAM'S ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR PTY LTDInstallation started morning 8 AM and finished at 3 PM.Clean work.

Quoting was easy worked to suit our needs. There was an issue around panel configuration but it was sorted out. One of the installers was a bit heavy handed, but nothing was broken during the install. The electrician was knowledgeable and offered great advice to make most of system. The invertor did have some configuration issues but these were related to the WiFi remote access service from the manufacturer. Price was half some of the quotes we received. System has worked flawlessly for last 3 months.
